userStories.title: Remove four no-op config keys behind a warn-and-strip guard
acceptanceCriteria: When `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` receives all four removed paths and an injected warn sink, then the sink is invoked exactly four times and each message names exactly one of `execution.rectification.escalateOnExhaustion`, `tdd.autoVerifyIsolation`, `tdd.autoApproveVerifier`, or `acceptance.generateTests`.
When `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` receives `tdd.autoVerifyIsolation`, then its returned `tdd` object omits `autoVerifyIsolation` while the input object still contains that property.
When `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` receives no removed paths, then it invokes the injected warn sink zero times and returns a value deeply equal to its input.
When `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` strips a removed `tdd` sibling, then the returned configuration retains the original `tdd.maxRetries` value.
When `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` strips a removed `acceptance` sibling, then the returned configuration retains the original `acceptance.enabled` value.
When `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` strips a removed `execution.rectification` sibling, then the returned configuration retains the original `execution.rectification.abortOnNoProgress` value.
When `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` receives a configuration with no `tdd` property, then it invokes the sink zero times, does not throw, and returns the configuration unchanged.
When `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` receives `{ tdd: 42 }`, then it invokes the sink zero times, does not throw, and returns `tdd` equal to `42`.
When `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` receives `tdd.autoVerifyIsolation: "yes"`, then it strips the property and invokes the warn sink once with a message containing `tdd.autoVerifyIsolation`.
Given a project `.nax/config.json` setting `tdd.autoVerifyIsolation` to `false`, when `loadConfig` resolves it, then the returned `tdd` section has no `autoVerifyIsolation` property.
Given a global config setting `acceptance.generateTests` to `false` and no project config, when `loadConfig` resolves it, then the returned `acceptance` section has no `generateTests` property.

Given both global and project config set `execution.rectification.escalateOnExhaustion`, when `loadConfig` resolves them, then the returned `execution.rectification` section has no `escalateOnExhaustion` property.
Given a per-package overlay setting `tdd.autoApproveVerifier`, when `loadConfigForWorkdir` resolves that package, then the returned `tdd` section has no `autoApproveVerifier` property.
When `NaxConfigSchema` parses an empty object, then `execution.rectification` has no `escalateOnExhaustion` property.
When `NaxConfigSchema` parses an empty object, then `tdd` has no `autoVerifyIsolation` property.
When `NaxConfigSchema` parses an empty object, then `tdd` has no `autoApproveVerifier` property.
When `NaxConfigSchema` parses an empty object, then `acceptance` has no `generateTests` property.
When `FIELD_DESCRIPTIONS` is queried for `execution.rectification.escalateOnExhaustion`, then it returns `undefined`.
When `FIELD_DESCRIPTIONS` is queried for `tdd.autoVerifyIsolation`, then it returns `undefined`.
When `FIELD_DESCRIPTIONS` is queried for `tdd.autoApproveVerifier`, then it returns `undefined`.
When `FIELD_DESCRIPTIONS` is queried for `acceptance.generateTests`, then it returns `undefined`.
When `FIELD_DESCRIPTIONS` is queried for `acceptance.enabled`, then it returns a non-empty string.

routing.reasoning: The change spans established configuration seams and many mechanical fixture edits, but its single new guard has explicit behavior and no new abstraction beyond existing shim patterns.

modifiedFiles.reason: the whole file (106 lines) exists to assert `escalateOnExhaustion` is defined on `RectificationConfig`, defaults to `true`, is overridable to `false`, and has a `FIELD_DESCRIPTIONS` entry. Every assertion pins the removed field. Delete the file; the invariant that replaces it is AC-7 and AC-11 below — the key is stripped on load and is absent from the parsed defaults.

the `test.each` table at line 290 has a `"generateTests"` row asserting per-package override of `acceptance.generateTests`. Delete that row only; the surviving `"enabled"` and `"testPath"` rows preserve the real invariant, that per-package acceptance overrides still apply.

two `RectificationConfig` object literals (lines 21 and 93) set `escalateOnExhaustion: true`. Remove the property from both; the surrounding rectification assertions are unaffected and must continue to pass.

its shared `NaxConfig` fixture sets `escalateOnExhaustion` under `execution.rectification` and both `autoVerifyIsolation` and `autoApproveVerifier` under `tdd`. Remove those three properties; every debate-schema assertion is unrelated to them and must continue to pass.

calls `TddConfigSchema.parse({...})` with `autoVerifyIsolation` and `autoApproveVerifier` supplied. Remove both from the parse inputs; the session-tier default assertions the file actually makes must continue to pass.
its config fixture supplies `autoVerifyIsolation`, `autoApproveVerifier` and `acceptance.generateTests`. Remove all three; the smart-runner flag assertions are unrelated and must continue to pass.
same three keys in its config fixture. Remove them; the smart-runner config resolution assertions must continue to pass.
its `NaxConfig` fixture supplies `autoVerifyIsolation`, `autoApproveVerifier` and `acceptance.generateTests`. Remove all three; the story-size-gate threshold assertions must continue to pass.
same three keys in its fixture. Remove them; the gate-routing assertions must continue to pass.

its config fixture sets `acceptance.generateTests`. Remove it; acceptance-pipeline behaviour is governed by `acceptance.enabled`, which the file's assertions already exercise and which must continue to pass.
its config fixture supplies `autoVerifyIsolation`, `autoApproveVerifier` and `acceptance.generateTests`. Remove all three; the pipeline event-ordering assertions must continue to pass.
same three keys in its fixture. Remove them; the routing final-state assertions must continue to pass.

userStories.title: Delete the dead interact CLI surface and status branch
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Delete the unregistered `nax interact` handlers and unreachable pending-interaction status display without changing the surrounding feature-status output.

**Motivation** — `nax interact list` could only ever print "No pending interactions", while `respond` and `cancel` could only ever throw "Interaction request not found".

**Approach** — Deletes `src/cli/interact.ts`, `src/cli/constitution.ts`, their `src/cli/index.ts` barrel re-exports, and the unreachable pending-interactions block in `src/cli/status-features.ts`.

**Scope** — In: remove the CLI modules, barrel exports, and `Waiting for Interaction` branch; adjust status regression coverage. Out: deleting the interaction state module and its barrel exports (US-003); registering `nax interact`; modifying the live interaction chain, triggers, bridge builder, or plugins.

**Interface** — No new public interface is introduced; this story removes the unregistered CLI command surface.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a feature directory with an `interactions` subdirectory containing one well-formed pending request, when the `nax status` feature display runs, then its output contains no `Waiting for Interaction` text.
Given that same feature directory, when the `nax status` feature display runs, then its output includes the PRD feature name.
Given that same feature directory, when the `nax status` feature display runs, then its output includes the feature story listing.

routing.reasoning: A contained deletion across CLI exports and one status display branch, with output regression coverage.

outOfScope: Deleting the orphaned interaction state layer (US-003).

userStories.title: Delete the orphaned interaction state layer
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove the disk-persistence interaction state module after its CLI consumers have been deleted, while preserving in-process interaction responses.

**Motivation** — The disk-based protocol is orphaned end to end: nothing ever writes `<featureDir>/interactions/`, and `<featureDir>/responses/` is written only by `interact.ts` and read by nobody.

**Approach** — Terminal cleanup. Deletes `src/interaction/state.ts` in full and its re-exports from `src/interaction/index.ts`. Every consumer is removed by US-002, so this story adds no production code. Carries one regression guard proving the in-process interaction path is unaffected.

**Scope** — In: delete `state.ts`, its barrel exports, and add the in-process chain regression assertion. Out: the CLI deletion and status branch removal (US-002); building a disk-backed producer; modifications to `chain.ts`, `triggers.ts`, `bridge-builder.ts`, or plugins.

**Interface** — No new interface is introduced; all eight state exports and the `RunState` type from `src/interaction/state.ts` are removed. The unrelated local `RunState` interface at `src/plugins/builtin/otel-reporter/index.ts:55` must not be touched.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an `InteractionChain` configured with `AutoInteractionPlugin`, when it resolves a `human-review` interaction request through the in-process path, then the returned response `requestId` matches the submitted request ID.

routing.reasoning: Terminal module and barrel deletion with a focused regression assertion against the unchanged in-process path.

analysis:
This is a refactor of an existing Bun/TypeScript CLI with a layered Zod configuration system. `src/config/loader.ts` merges defaults, global, project, profile, and CLI layers; the root chain invokes its pre-parse reject guards immediately before `NaxConfigSchema.safeParse` at `src/config/loader.ts:353-361`. `loadConfigForWorkdir` first caches `loadConfig`, then applies a per-package override/profile and invokes the same guards before its own parse at `src/config/loader.ts:486-489`. The existing `defaultConfigWarn` wraps `getLogger().warn("config", msg)` at `src/config/loader.ts:52-59`; use it as the guard default, while direct unit calls inject a warn sink. Root config caching means loader-altitude tests must call `_clearRootConfigCache` between isolated fixture cases, as existing loader tests do.

The four no-op keys are currently declared in `src/config/schemas-execution.ts:76,337-338` and `src/config/schemas-infra.ts:41`, included in defaults in `src/config/schemas.ts:130,218-219,291`, required by `src/config/runtime-types.ts:70,232,236,305`, and advertised by `src/cli/config-descriptions.ts:83,123,125,181`. Their fixture-only references span config, execution, verification, precheck, pipeline, routing, and prompt tests; remove only the literal properties whose requirement disappears, delete `test/unit/config/escalate-on-exhaustion.test.ts`, and remove only the `generateTests` table row in `test/unit/config/merge.test.ts`. `src/config/merge.ts:22` needs its stale acceptance deep-merge comment corrected but its spread-based code must remain unchanged. The guard must use object/path presence rather than values, preserve siblings, avoid mutation, and leave missing/non-object parents for Zod. Post-merge placement prevents duplicate warnings when global and project layers both set a removed key. Backward compatibility is intentionally warn-and-strip: existing inert configuration continues to load while a logger warning makes the removal audible.

The dead CLI/interaction surface is structurally isolated. Graph inspection finds `interactListCommand`, `interactRespondCommand`, and `interactCancelCommand` at `src/cli/interact.ts` with no inbound callers, while `savePendingInteraction` at `src/interaction/state.ts:122` has zero callers. `loadPendingInteraction` is called only by those dead commands and the pending-interaction block in `displayFeatureDetails` (`src/cli/status-features.ts:279-320`). `src/cli/index.ts:49-51` and `src/interaction/index.ts:25-36` expose the deleted symbols. Delete the CLI handlers, unused `constitution.ts`, the state module, related barrel exports, and the status block. Do not change the live in-process interaction graph: `InteractionChain` is exported from `src/interaction/index.ts:22`, and existing tests under `test/unit/interaction/` and `test/integration/interaction/` cover the plugins and chain. Update the existing status feature test for surrounding status output and add an in-process AutoInteractionPlugin regression assertion. The unrelated `RunState` in `src/plugins/builtin/otel-reporter/index.ts:55` remains untouched. Migration is removal-only: users retaining a removed config key receive one warning per resolved config; there is no disk interaction protocol to migrate because no producer exists.
outOfScope: Building a disk-backed producer for pending interactions. The in-process `InteractionChain` path remains the only interaction mechanism in nax.
Registering `nax interact` as a CLI command, in this or any follow-up implied by this spec.
Implementing tier escalation on rectification exhaustion, i.e. US-002 and US-003 of `docs/specs/SPEC-rectification-escalation.md`. That spec is retired as won't-do by this work.
Converting `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` into a throwing guard, or converting any of the four existing `reject*` guards into warn-and-strip. The divergence is deliberate and documented.
Consolidating the four existing `reject*` guards or the three pre-merge shims into a shared table-driven mechanism.
Adding replacement configuration keys for any of the four removed keys.
Making isolation verification, verifier auto-approval, or acceptance test generation conditionally disableable. Each currently runs unconditionally and continues to.

Adding test coverage for existing `AutoInteractionPlugin` decision behaviour, including its refusal to auto-approve requests whose metadata trigger is `security-review`. That guard already exists at `src/interaction/plugins/auto.ts:128`, is unchanged by this work, and a test for it could not fail first.
Changing the behaviour of `acceptance.enabled`, which remains the single switch governing acceptance test generation.
